_comment: Everything about YOUR channel lives here. Change values in this file rather than editing code - every script reads from it.

channel.angle: I expose how everyday financial products - mortgages, credit, insurance, and debt - are quietly draining people who feel like they can't get ahead no matter what they do, who profits from it, and how bad it gets, using real filings, real data and charts.

video._comment: YouTube unlocks mid-roll ads at 8:00. 10-12 min is the sweet spot.
video._letterbox_comment: true adds 2.39:1 cinema bars over footage. Off by default: bars shrink the picture on phones, where most views happen.

storyboard._comment: Shot planning, done after narration against the real word timings (pipeline/storyboard.py). All footage is planned as stock, cut where the narration changes subject; the stock stage fills a shot with as many short clips as it needs and only shots no library can show become AI. Cards are ColdFusion-style question/fact cards and numbers are big key-figure shots - both capped, never captions.

charts3d._comment: GPT-6 Astra (OPENAI_API_KEY) writes a bespoke three.js/Remotion component for every chart shot, designed for that data and line of narration. Each must pass static rules, tsc, a full test render and a vision read-back of its numbers, or it falls back to the built-in chart (pipeline/charts3d.py). Big-number shots always use the built-in component. Prices per million tokens as of 14 Sep 2026; reasoning tokens bill as output.

visuals._comment: AI visuals via fal.ai (FAL_KEY). Every AI shot gets a keyframe image; the highest-priority ones are animated with image-to-video until the estimate hits budget_usd, the rest get depth-parallax camera moves (free, rendered in three.js). Generated files are cached by content hash in runs/<id>/assets/gen/, so reruns cost nothing. Prices are per call/second as of 14 Sep 2026 - check fal.ai/models when switching models; the budget cap is only as accurate as this table. Motion at 768P is scaled to 1080p in render; '1080P' roughly doubles motion cost.

models._comment: Model IDs change. If a call 404s, check the provider's docs and update here - no code change needed.

writer._comment: Renamed Sept 2026: 'deepseek-v4-flash' became 'deepseek-flash' (V4.1 Flash) on 10 Sep. 'deepseek-v4-pro' reroutes to V4.1 Flash from 04:00 UTC on 14 Sep, so polish_model points there too until V4.1 Pro ships - then change polish_model back to it.

writer_fallback._comment: gemini-3.1-flash was retired; renamed to gemini-3.5-flash. Moved to gemini-3.8-flash on 15 Sep 2026: newer, and $0.75/$3.75 per 1M tokens vs 3.5 Flash's $1.50/$9.00 (introductory until 31 Dec 2026, then $1.50/$7.50).

tts._comment: Default is ElevenLabs since 15 Sep 2026: Gemini's voice changed between chunks (heard at 2:19 in the 14 Sep build). eleven_multilingual_v2 is ElevenLabs' most stable long-form model (10k chars/request, $0.10 per 1k chars as of Sep 2026). Voice id is 'Bren' (Irish, from the voice library, chosen by ear 15 Sep 2026 over Charlie/Brian/Adam/Bill; the documentary read is kept - stability 0.6, no conversational styling). Bren reads ~14% faster than Charlie, which keeps an 11-12 minute target in reach - swap for any id from elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library, avoiding voices that show a custom-rate credit multiplier. 'gemini', 'qwen' and 'speechify' still work.
tts._style_comment: Prepended to every narration chunk as a spoken-style instruction (Gemini TTS follows it and does not read it aloud - verified 14 Sep 2026). Empty string for the voice's natural read (the default - a British RP style was tried 14 Sep 2026 and the natural read was preferred).

thumbnail._comment: Three concepts from the polish pass (or generated here for older runs) -> one image each with image_model -> Pillow draws the text and symbol -> a vision model runs the shrink test and ranks them. thumbnail.jpg is the winner; _b and _c are for YouTube Studio's Test & Compare.

safety._comment: review_only=true means the pipeline NEVER publishes. It builds the video and hands it to you. Flip to false only after your Phase 1 numbers say the format works.

targets._comment: From Phase 9.3 of the plan. Used by the topic engine as context.
